description_en: Uploads a certificate, including a standard Chinese national cryptographic (China SM) certificate or a non-China SM certificate
description_zh: 本接口一般用于上传证书，包括标准国密证书或非国密证书
name: UploadUserCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The custom certificate name. Maximum length: 63 characters. All character types are supported, including letters, digits, and underscores.
Certificate names must be unique within the same user account
parameters.help_zh:
自定义的证书名称。支持的最大字符长度：63。支持所有字符类型，包括字母、数字、下划线等。
同一个用户下的证书名称不能重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The non-China SM certificate content in PEM format
parameters.help_zh: 非国密证书，PEM格式证书内容
parameters.name: cert

parameters.help_en: The private key content of the non-China SM certificate in PEM format
parameters.help_zh: 非国密证书 ，PEM格式证书的私钥内容
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The encryption certificate content of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty
parameters.help_zh: 国密证书，PEM格式加密证书内容。当Cert和Key不为空时，此字段无效
parameters.name: encrypt_cert

parameters.example:
-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
MHcCAQEEI****
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The private key content of the encryption certificate of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty
parameters.help_zh: 国密证书，PEM格式加密证书私钥内容。当Cert和Key不为空时，此字段无效
parameters.name: encrypt_private_key

parameters.help_en: The signing certificate content of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty
parameters.help_zh: 国密证书，PEM格式签名证书内容。当Cert和Key不为空时，此字段无效
parameters.name: sign_cert

parameters.example:
-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
MHcCAQEEILR****
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The private key content of the signing certificate of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty
parameters.help_zh: 国密证书，PEM格式签名证书私钥内容。当Cert和Key不为空时，此字段无效
parameters.name: sign_private_key

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

ResourceId.description_en: The instance ID of the certificate to operate on
